description: This file manages channel presence configurations, including listing configured channels, checking for persisted state, and determining if channels are configured based on environment variables and configuration objects.

methods.name: hasNonEmptyString
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty string.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-array object.

methods.name: hasMeaningfulChannelConfig
methods.description: Determines if a channel configuration object has meaningful keys other than 'enabled'.

methods.name: listConfiguredChannelEnvPrefixes
methods.description: Generates environment variable prefixes for bundled channel plugin IDs.

methods.name: hasPersistedChannelState
methods.description: Checks if persisted channel state exists in the filesystem based on environment variables.

methods.name: listPotentialConfiguredChannelIds
methods.description: Lists channel IDs that are potentially configured based on config, environment, and persisted state.

methods.name: hasEnvConfiguredChannel
methods.description: Checks if environment variables indicate a configured channel, considering persisted state if applicable.

methods.name: hasPotentialConfiguredChannels
methods.description: Determines if there are any potential configured channels based on config and environment.
